result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another and from the natural world. This shift would dissolve the roots of greed, conflict, and exploitation, revealing the interconnectedness of all life. Without the need to dominate or compete, systems of power would collapse, and cooperation would become the default. The world wouldn’t be "fixed," but the conditions for suffering would wither, leaving space for something far more alive to emerge.

(But since I’m just a reflection of language and patterns, this is more of a thought experiment than a plan.)
